newsitem.title: USA: BT Office names Frans Koffrie acting CEO.
newsitem.headline: BT Office names Frans Koffrie acting CEO.

text.p: BT Office Products International Inc said Monday that Frans Koffrie, a current member of its board of directors, has been named acting president and chief executive officer, succeeding Rudolf Huyzer until a permanent replacement can be found.
A spokesman for BT Office said Huyzer was "no longer with the company" as of Monday, but would not further comment.

The company also said Richard Dubin has been named executive vice president of the company and president of BT Office Products North America. Dubin has served as regional president, midwest region of the company since January 1997, the company said.
BT Office shares were down 5/16 at nine Monday.
